blocks.text: ANTIPOLO—TNT turned Magnolia’s concerns into a reality and came away with a 92-70 victory to claim Game 1 of their best-of-five series in the PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals on Sunday at Ynares Center here. Rondae Hollis-Jefferson delivered 26 points, nine rebounds, five assists and three steals to help lead the Tropang 5G’s commanding performance while also ending the Hotshots’ six-game winning streak. It took late in the second quarter for TNT to take control of the contest, with Hollis-Jefferson getting ample support from the likes of Calvin Oftana, RR Pogoy, Rey Nambatac and Brandon Ganuelas-Rosser.
